rungs.title: Beat an elite that dug in

monsters.name: Paper Imp
monsters.note: A memo that got up and walked, held together mostly by staples. It wants to be read and goes to pieces when it is not. The shredder stops it for good. Put it in recycling and it may come back as a different memo.

monsters.name: Rogue Roomba
monsters.note: Facilities bought it to clean the floor. It cleans the floor of anything it can reach, ankles included. Flip it on its back and it beeps until the battery goes, which is about three hours longer than anyone can bear.

monsters.name: Stapler Mimic
monsters.note: It is an ordinary stapler until a hand gets near it. The red ones are the worst, and nobody has ever seen one being bought. Unjam it properly and it goes back to being office supplies for a while.

monsters.name: Dust Daemon
monsters.note: It grows behind the monitors when nobody dusts, and it breathes out every time you breathe in. A can of compressed air sends it to the vents, where it waits for the next quiet month.

biomes.name: Office Cubicles
biomes.note: Where every hero starts, and where every hero wakes up after a bad day. The printer is always jammed and the plant by the window is plastic. Nothing here keeps you down for long, because someone always walks past with a first-aid kit.

stances.blurb: Drinks and rests early, and heals up before heading back out. Learns a little less from each win.
stances.name: Cautious

stances.blurb: Saves potions and keeps exploring on low health, then heads back out as soon as it can stand. Learns more from each win.
stances.name: Bold

affix.blurb: More gold from wins and finds.
affix.name: Lucky
